summary: Verified iter40 KN ERP session: design gallery final (mockup+source only, no colorway), source file upload/download/delete flow, RND sample creation with consolidated spec (spec_id/spec_number & master_data), full send→submit→assess→decide flow (403 for creator, manager decide with color sync to color_library and product master lifecycle=disetujui). Frontend design detail page timeline, final tab, gallery showcase and RND UI all match spec.

issues: gallery-showcase-products testid rendered only when recommended_products non-empty; for design without products the section shows Empty state without the testid. Not a functional bug but the request expected the testid to be present. Consider keeping the container div with data-testid=gallery-showcase-products and rendering Empty inside it for stable testability.

action_items: OPTIONAL: keep data-testid='gallery-showcase-products' rendered even when list empty (currently only rendered when d.recommended_products has items).

OPTIONAL: seed at least one assessed sample with a real color_target.color_id (labdip) so QA can visually verify decide-supplier-color-name/code fields (currently the conditional renders correctly, verified in source, but no assessed seed sample has color_id set).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend upload_kind_file returns single file meta (fmeta) — router response contract is stable, but caller docs in the task assumed files[] response; documentation of return shape could be clarified.
color-library router has no GET-by-id endpoint (only list, nearest, POST, PATCH, DELETE). Consider adding GET /color-library/{id} for single-fetch scenarios used by supplier variant verification.
seed_data_creation: Created KSC/SMP-00032 via UI (admin) — labdip with spec KSC/SPEC-00006 (TSTUI-<unique>). Backend tests created several TEST_iter40 samples + decisions (product SKU TST-<unique>). No cleanup of created samples because rnd/samples has no delete endpoint; they're prefixed TEST_ per convention.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter40_design_rnd.py runs 8 tests: gallery final requirement, source upload/download/delete, colorway kind still accepted, invalid kind 400, sample-create-with-spec+master_data, send+submit+assess flow, admin-creator-decide 403, manager decide+master_data+color_library. Run with `pytest backend/tests/test_iter40_design_rnd.py -n 0`. UI flows fully verified: designer detail page has design-round-block-1/2/final, design-round-comment-1, design-round-acc-2, no design-tab-versions, no design-files-colorway; final tab source upload works. Gallery showcase modal shows all sections; gallery-filter-rnd 'Proofing berjalan' → gallery-filter-empty then reset works. Sample form modal spec section works. Manager sample detail sample-master-* & sample-decision-color 'Navy 07 (NV-07)' verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only 1 minor testability nit and 2 optional API enhancements documented above.
